prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production main menu background for a Chinese real-time strategy game called Cell War. Create an exquisite panoramic 16:9 illustrated microcosm inside a human body. Cinematic hand-painted premium game art, luminous translucent turquoise and jade cells with tiny friendly eyes, sapphire nuclei and gold organelles, an organic colony with glowing membrane nests, violet neural filaments, amber nutrient crystals, coral capillary branches, soft plum tissue. Camera nearly top-down with subtle depth, elegant richly detailed organic materials, mature polished illustration, no cartoon outline. Composition: left 45 percent is quiet very dark navy/teal atmospheric negative space for real UI title and buttons; right half shows a large turquoise nucleus colony and six small differentiated cell warriors, framed by organic tissue. High contrast focused bioluminescence, restrained luminous cyan and warm gold against deep navy and plum. No lettering, no logos, no UI, no borders, no humans, no weapons, no outdoor environment, no watermark. Output landscape 1536x1024 or wider.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent production sprite atlas of sixteen top-down organic buildings for a polished microcosm RTS Cell War. EXACT layout: square canvas divided into uniform 4 columns x 4 rows, no visible grid. ONE centered isolated object in each equal square, generous fully transparent gutters, every object fits within 76 percent of its cell. Camera strict orthographic TOP DOWN, circular flat living membrane architecture, translucent jade/cyan material, sapphire nuclei, golden organelles, hand-painted luminous premium game illustration, crisp silhouette at small scale, consistent lighting, no ground or shadows, no text. Reading row major left to right: Row1: 1 large core colony with concentric membranes and central blue nucleus; 2 round nutrient warehouse with amber sacs; 3 paired jade shelter bubbles; 4 small bioluminescent gland with glowing gold center. Row2: 5 nutrient conversion pool amber rosette; 6 rectangular rounded cultivation bed with six green pods; 7 violet DNA research station with double helix; 8 spiked teal division barracks with five nuclei. Row3: 9 poison hatchery with lime green toxin sacs; 10 large macrophage hatchery with three cyan lobes; 11 repair gland with mint luminous cross formed by organelles; 12 a short horizontal strip of interlinked pink membrane wall. Row4: 13 membrane gate two pink pads separated by a clearly open narrow center; 14 circular defense turret six radial jade tentacles; 15 hostile infection nest purple spiny fungus with red nucleus; 16 golden DNA helix emblem. Uniform positions and same visual size except naturally small gland and wall. Genuine transparent alpha background, no checkerboard, no lettering, no cell eyes, no humans, no sci-fi machinery, no watermark. Output 2048x2048.
